principle: Independent geometry, event ordering, authority and browser observations decide qualification; implementation telemetry is diagnostic support, never sole truth where independent observation is possible.

contracts.pass: No abnormal 6+ player point cluster or whole-line convergence persists without set-piece/scramble cause.
contracts.fail: 6+ non-goalkeeper players within a small local radius, or 7+ sharing a narrow band, persists in open play.
contracts.falsePositive: camera/coordinate transform and genuine penalty-box contest

contracts.pass: ST/FB/CB/CM excursions remain explainable by possession, transition, marking, recovery or restart cause.
contracts.fail: isolated extreme ST depth or role-group collapse lacks a current cause for the window.
contracts.mutation: deep ST; FB/CB/CM excursion; line collapse

contracts.pass: Material central/wide threats have pressure, mark, cover, screening or explicit handoff ownership; duplicate ownership does not abandon another threat.
contracts.fail: dangerous attack lane is silently unowned, or duplicate PRESS/MARK consumes cover while another material threat is abandoned.
exceptions: explicit emergency double-team with remaining cover
contracts.mutation: remove central owner; all defenders chase carrier; duplicate target

contracts.pass: Motion is bounded and target changes are causally distinct; no multi-player reset at choice boundary.
contracts.fail: same-epoch A-B-A target oscillation, unexplained multi-player relocation, or distinct responsibilities receive identical destination.
contracts.mutation: boundary teleport; identical defender tx/ty; target flip

contracts.window: handoff through first visible choice frame
contracts.pass: Same causal state (clock/score/possession/ball/22 identities) descends into first scene and future outcome is absent before commit.
contracts.fail: new board/reset, causal mismatch, future result, or execution not descended from exact choiceId+targetId.
contracts.mutation: replace handoff; change selected target; prefill outcome

contracts.pass: Only a user commit of an offered exact pair can arm hero pass/shot/dribble/tackle/restart.
contracts.fail: unselected hero action, target substitution, or hover/recommendation/focus execution.
contracts.falsePositive: test harness must identify synthetic input
contracts.mutation: auto action; altered target; click recommendation hover

contracts.pass: Kickoff/corner/free-kick/throw/goal-kick/goal restart has a causal trigger, legal team/ball geometry and coherent possession transition.
contracts.fail: wrong-end/setup, impossible possession, invalid restart sequence or material offside/restart contradiction.
contracts.mutation: wrong kickoff side; invalid corner; stale restart owner

contracts.pass: Each authoritative shot reaches exactly one visible causal outcome; goal updates score then aftermath/kickoff; shot-out corner is visible.
contracts.fail: goal disappears, score/narrative contradicts event, or corner terminal is dropped.
exceptions: blocked shot followed by continuing live ball
contracts.mutation: drop GOAL; omit CORNER; suppress score update

contracts.window: choice open and flight decision window
contracts.pass: Each meaningful current target is rendered or causally excluded; afforded feet/lead alternatives and feasible incoming one-touch window are represented; recommendation is annotation.
contracts.fail: material target silently omitted, real flight window passes without choice, or recommendation executes/changes authority.
exceptions: structured exclusion: offside, blocked lane, unreachable, unsafe
contracts.mutation: hide viable target; remove flight prompt; promote recommendation

contracts.pass: Same-seed reset is labelled deterministic; New Seed changes session seed; role change is explicit and traceable.
contracts.fail: New Seed replays identical deterministic session unintentionally or lifecycle metadata lies.
contracts.mutation: fixed new-match seed; hidden trial reset

contracts.pass: Every requested item is classified deployed/unproven/not implemented/watch; unresolved items are exposed.
contracts.fail: candidate calls untouched, WATCH, not-deployed or user-unproven work complete.
contracts.mutation: remove ledger entry; mislabel WATCH as pass

contracts.pass: Complete recursively discovered user-path closure exactly matches candidate payload; scripts-only manifests are rejected.
contracts.fail: any visible dependency mismatch, missing CSS/asset, unexpected shadow load, or unverified dynamic asset.
exceptions: immutable external platform asset pinned by digest
contracts.mutation: stale CSS; omitted image; swapped dynamic script
